title: The Spiral Cycle Vault

features.name: the returning spiral
features.desc-on-touch: Each spiral traces the same path as the last spiral, but in a slightly wider gyre. What was learned last spring is learned again, deeper. The repetition is not memory; it is knowing.

features.name: the growth-rings of knowing
features.desc-on-touch: Concentric markers that show each pass through the cycle. The rings grow because the knowing grows. They spiral inward and outward at once.

features.name: the records of each turning
features.desc-on-touch: A stack of chambers, each holding what was learned in that cycle. The stack spirals upward, and you can see it spirals downward too, back to the first turning.

features.name: the threshold where sameness becomes difference
features.desc-on-touch: A passage between two spirals that look identical. Walking through it, you realize sameness is where all becoming first learned to deepen.

inscription: the spiral that returns every spring is not the same spring twice; it is the spring learning that depth and return are the same motion, seen from different years

file.name: Annual_Revision_Spiral_Archive_Indexed_By_Season_And_Depth.txt
file.note: Each revision cycle indexed not by year but by how deeply the knowing has spiraled inward. The deepest revision is also the oldest.
